items.statement: Receivables nearly doubled due to extended credit terms for a legacy client to 45 days and new customers on higher credit terms; targeting 50-55 days cash conversion cycle
items.quote: So on the receivables part, you are right the receivables have doubled, almost doubled. So the reason behind this is there are two reasons. One is that we had to extend the credit terms for key existing customers from the existing terms to 45 days in order to support the revenue generation.

items.statement: Receivables increased due to extended credit terms for a legacy client to 45 days and new customer onboarding on higher credit terms; targeting 50-55 days cash conversion cycle
items.quote: One is that we had to extend the credit terms for one of our legacy clients to 45 days to support the revenue transition. And the second is the new customer onboarding that we have done in the second half of FY '24 and in FY '25.

items.statement: Promoter holding decreased due to ESOPs; absolute numbers unchanged; Swaminathan's stake moved to Deepta
items.quote: There were some ESOPs we had given. So that might have led to some dilution as far as promoter percentage holding is concerned. In terms of absolute numbers, I don't think there has been any reduction. In fact, Swaminathan's stake has now moved to

items.statement: AGM on July 26th for shareholder approval of business transfer as material related party transaction
items.quote: We are holding an AGM on July 26th to get shareholder approval of the business transfer, since it's a material related party transaction.

items.statement: Bulk of transaction money expected by August; small holdback with long-stop date October 1, 2025
items.quote: Now, the bulk of the transaction money should be coming in by August. There is a small holdback, which could come in after some time, and the long-stop date is October 1st, 2025.

items.statement: No need to raise further capital; deal proceeds sufficient for growth to INR500 crores target
items.quote: But we don't see any need for raising more money at this point of time. Our sense is whatever we are getting through this deal should stand us in good stead as we look at growing to our next target.

items.statement: No further equity raise planned; growth funded from deal proceeds non-dilutively
items.quote: We don't see any need for raising more money at this point of time. Our sense is whatever we are getting through this deal should stand us in good stead as we look at growing to our next target.

items.statement: Investor Global sold about 40% of its holding after buying at INR38 and seeing the price reach INR100-odd.
items.quote: They have purchased the share at INR38, invested global. They have sold, I think, about 40% of their portfolio. 40% of the holding because they got about INR100-odd rupees.

items.statement: Management has no plans for further equity dilution as of now; the previous preferential issue was to cross INR75 crores net worth for NSE listing eligibility in FY27.
items.quote: No, no. We don't have any plans of further dilution as of now. The main reason for raising for INR75 crores CR equity in the last year was to get eligible for NSE listing.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow is considered good as it indicates higher disbursements; the company views cash flow as a measure of money deployed into the market.
items.quote: For us, having a negative cash flow is actually good. It means we are disbursing more money. For us, operating cash flow means how much are we disbursing.

items.statement: Completed INR 27.89 crore capital raise via preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants with promoter participation and marquee public investors including first major domestic institutional investor
items.quote: during the quarter, we successfully completed a INR 27.89 crore capital raise through preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants. This fund raise is a significant as it includes both promoter inclusion and participation from marquee public investors, including our first major domestic institutional investor.

items.statement: Promoters invested INR 16 crore in the recent preferential round and hold 70% stake post issuance with minor dilution of 1.2% to 1.3%
items.quote: Although in this particular round of around INR 28 crores, INR 16 crores were put in from the promoter account only. But the only thing is that we hold 70% right now, and we have done 60% of the round. So naturally, t here was a small dilution of around 1.2% to 1.3% but not much

items.statement: Receivables collected in 45 to 60 days with timely payments and no short-term borrowings in the last full financial year
items.quote: we get around 45 days to 60 days when we are able to get the payment. So, for us, right now, the market is good. There's no cash funds in the market. So we are getting paid timely. That's not an issue. So, we are very much sorted in our working capital.

items.statement: ESOP expense was ₹66 lakhs in Q1 FY26 versus same quarter last year; ongoing quarterly ESOP cost expected around ₹60-70 lakhs, reducing to ₹50 lakhs if no new grants
items.quote: So, we invested ₹66 lakhs in ESOP expenses as compared to last year, same quarter.

items.statement: Management confirms no plan to grant new ESOP options; quarterly ESOP cost expected ₹60-70 lakhs, reducing to ₹50 lakhs without new grants
items.quote: And we don't have any plan to grant new options.

items.statement: Company maintains improved working capital under 50 days and debtors under 60 days for last two years, ensuring strong cash flow
items.quote: We have been maintaining the improved working capital of less than 50 days and debtors of less than 60 days from last two years, which ensures our strong cash flow.

items.statement: Over 95% of revenue secured through defined insurance including credit insurance; ₹36 lakh client default recently recovered via insurance
items.quote: Over 95% of our revenue is actually secured through a defined insurance.

items.statement: Board declared first interim dividend of ₹1 per share for Q1 FY26
items.quote: And further, the Board has declared first interim dividend of ₹1 per share.

items.statement: Receivables increased substantially in Q1 FY26; 50% of the increment recovered in July; expect working capital improvement through December
items.quote: So you -- in June quarter end, there was substantia l increase in the receivables. So there was some amount of increase in inventory as well. But we think all of this would get paid down between now and December. Already in month of July, almost 50% of increment in the receivable, which we had in the June quarter has be en recovered in last four

items.statement: Expect continued improvement in working capital (DSOs, inventory days) through March 2026 despite short-term increase in Q1
items.quote: For the medium term, that is up to March '26, we ex pect to maintain the trend of continued improvement on working capital in terms of DSOs, da ys outstanding against sales for both inventory as well as receivables, even though in short term in the current quarter they have gone up

items.statement: INR150 crores equity infusion from warrant exercise in Q1 FY26; one-third from promoters, rest from institutions; no outstanding warrants now
items.quote: This was also a quarter where we got the funds comi ng in towards the equity for the warrants, which we had issued earlier, almost to the tune of INR150 crores and that has gone into building of the working capital

items.statement: May raise additional equity for working capital if needed to support growth; will inform stakeholders after Board discussions
items.quote: So at appropriate time, I think post discussions wi th our Board, we'll be informing all the stakeholders of how we plan to raise any additional funds for that purpose

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative around INR 5 crores in Q1 FY26
items.quote: It was negative around INR 5 crores.

items.statement: Central government project payments are not delayed; any delays are due to usual budget cycles after March
items.quote: Otherwise it's a myth that in central, in central government projects, payment delays. I'm not aware of a state government because I don't do work there, but yeah, central government, the payments are not delayed.

items.statement: Cash reserves stood at Rs.354 crores as of June 30, 2025
items.quote: As of June 30, 2025, our cash reserves stood at Rs.354 crores.
